description: Add git trailer support to Git Control Tower's commit workflow. Trailer editor in commit panel for adding/editing/removing Vrooli-namespaced trailers. When using the 'continue' action on a previous commit: auto-increment part number in title, copy all Vrooli-* trailers from previous commit, add Vrooli-Continues trailer pointing to previous commit hash. Auto-suggest initiative slugs from recent trailer history.
name: gct-trailer-support
title: Trailer editor in commit panel with auto-population from continue action
